column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Descent Beneath the World
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: A hole leading down into the depths of the earth...
Ahh, it's pitch-black at the bottom. I can't see a thing.
Just how far down does it go?
To think the $$教皇$$ can do something like this... She is terrifying!
This is not the $$教皇$$'s doing.
It is purely a work of nature.
We seek a way to the far side of this $$世界$$.
The far side of the $$世界$$?!
Deep below, in darkness blacker than night, lies the path we must take.
(To think I would live to set foot in this place again...)
I'll be clear: from here on,
the farther we go, the more arduous and painful it will become...
There is no turning back now. We have to keep going.
